description: This file is a Jupyter Notebook (.ipynb) containing Python code that defines a subclass of torch.utils.data.IterDataPipe, specifically ExampleIterPipe, and demonstrates various data pipeline operations such as batch, unbatch, map, filter, shuffle, groupby, zip, fork, demux, mux, concat, and others. It includes detailed usage examples and documentation for each data transformation function.
